vulnerability_summary: OpenClaw trusted-proxy Control UI authentication bypassed device identity and pairing for node-role sessions.
causality: Cursor-coauthored atomic commit 4a7b813a introduced trustedProxyAuthOk and made it an unconditional allow path in evaluateMissingDeviceIdentity() and shouldSkipControlUiPairing(). Its predicate checked Control UI, trusted-proxy mode, authentication success, and auth method, while omitting the role. Before that commit, roleCanSkipDeviceIdentity(role, sharedAuthOk) preserved the operator-only boundary. Fix ec45c317 added role === "operator" to both trustedProxyAuthOk predicates, exactly excluding the node-role cases created by the Cursor-coauthored change. The AI-authored atomic diff therefore binds directly to both vulnerable decisions.

evidence.atomic_binding: 4a7b813a adds both unconditional trusted-proxy allow decisions; ec45c317 adds role === operator to the predicates feeding those decisions.
